# Thrive Trilogy — llms.txt

> Biochemistry-backed supplement analysis by Ziad Meras, M.Sc. Organic Chemistry (University of Batna, 2017).
> Specialist topics: NAD+ biology, NMN bioavailability, NR, TMG, methylation, berberine, dihydroberberine, alpha-ketoglutarate, resveratrol, spermidine, urolithin A, senolytics, mTOR/AMPK signalling, supplement delivery systems, longevity compounds.
> All content is chemistry-first, peer-reviewed citation standard, DSHEA compliant. No disease cure claims. Third-person expert reviewer voice.
